questions.question_text:
Jodie, Sama and Kay are each making a sign out of this piece of wood.
They cut it in the following way.
The parts for Jodie, Sama and Kay are respectively 1/2, 2/5 and 1/10 of the piece.
What is the ratio of parts for Jodie : Sama : Kay in its simplest form?

options.why: Treats the fractional parts as though they have a common denominator of one.
Uses the denominators and numerators in the wrong ratio.
All three fractional lengths are already provided in the diagram.

questions.solution_text: Multiply the fractions 1/2, 2/5 and 1/10 by 10 to clear the denominators. This gives 5 : 4 : 1, which is already in simplest form.

questions.question_text:
$\frac12$ of the counters in a bag are blue, $\frac3{10}$ of the counters are red, and $\frac15$ of the counters are purple.
Which of these show the ratio of blue : red : purple?

options.why: The blue fraction is not one third of the red fraction in this ratio.
These numbers do not preserve the given blue-to-red fraction ratio.
The entries do not match the fractions one half, three tenths and one fifth.

questions.solution_text: Use denominator 10: $\frac12=\frac5{10}$, $\frac3{10}=\frac3{10}$, and $\frac15=\frac2{10}$. Hence blue : red : purple $=5:3:2$.
